title: Chocolate Coca-Cola Cake (Partial — Video Only)
ingredients: 1 bottle/can Coca-Cola (original), used in place of the oil/water/eggs the box calls for
instructions: Combine the chocolate cake mix, instant chocolate pudding mix, and Coca-Cola in a large mixing bowl.
Pour the batter into a baking pan and bake following the cake mix box's time/temperature.
Make an icing that also incorporates Coca-Cola and pour it over the finished cake.
notes: Video only — creator Katelyn Kidwell held up the cake mix box, pudding box, and a Coca-Cola bottle on camera but did not state exact quantities, pan size, or bake time/temperature, and did not post a written recipe. There was some comment confusion over whether the pudding was chocolate or vanilla flavor (she said 'chocolate' on camera; most commenters agree it's chocolate instant pudding). Commenter Kaye Landrum noted the icing is also supposed to include Coca-Cola. Several commenters reminisced about an older from-scratch (non-cake-mix) version of Coca-Cola cake, sometimes made with a pecan icing.
